messages:
ada: Quick sanity check — we're targeting v2.3 for the devex release (SDKs + docs + sample apps). Proposed changelog cutoff: Mon Mar 30 23:59 UTC. Who's owning each piece? :calendar:

mike: I can own SDKs (python + js). I'll need final API surface reviews by Mar 28. Ping me on PRs. :eyes:

sofia: Docs team can handle quickstart updates and migration notes. Please mark any breaking changes in the PR description. We need at least one doc review slot on Mar 29.

jun: I'll own sample apps. Two items: update template to new auth flow, and add streaming example. ETA: Mar 29 for template, Mar 30 for streaming sample. Need an SDK review before streaming example is merged.

olivia: Release coordination here — I'll be cutting the changelog and coordinating the cutover. Confirming cutoff is Mar 30 23:59 UTC. After cutoff, only critical fixes with approvals. Can the SDK/docs owners confirm final PR freeze window? :shipit:

mike: Freeze window OK: no feature merges after Mar 29 18:00 UTC for SDKs, only bugfixes. I'll post the PR checklist.

sofia: Docs freeze: Mar 30 12:00 UTC — we need time to generate the site and run the link checker.

samir: Heads-up: eng-runtime team has a runtime change that may affect SDK batching behavior. We plan to land infra change on Mar 27. Mike, can we agree on a quick compatibility test matrix?

mike: Yep — I'll add automated tests against the runtime branch. If anything breaks, we'll feature-flag the change in the SDK.

lex: QA: we'll run regression suite on Mar 30 00:00 UTC and again after final merges. Please assign test cases: SDK core, quickstart flow, sample apps.

ada: To keep things explicit, action list:
- mike: SDK final reviews + PR checklist (due Mar 28)
- sofia: quickstart and migration docs (due Mar 29)
- jun: sample app template + streaming example (due Mar 30)
- samir: provide compatibility matrix and runtime test branch (Mar 26)
- lex: regression plan and test ownership (Mar 29)
- olivia: cut changelog and coordinate release (cutoff Mar 30 23:59)

ada: Also, changelog format — olivia suggested we use the standard header. Example to copy into changelog.md:
```
## v2.3 - 2026-03-31
### Added
- SDK: streaming client API
- Docs: new quickstart for private deployment
### Changed
- Runtime: improved KV cache behavior (opt-in)
```

mike: I'll add short PR templates referencing the above changelog sections.

sofia: Can someone confirm who will update release notes on the console UI? Marketing wants a short blurb.

olivia: I'll draft the blurb once I see the merged changelog. Marketing: @marketing please review after I share.

jun: Small dependency ask — sample apps need the new env var names changed in the infra repo. Samir, can you coordinate a small deploy window?

samir: Yes, I'll schedule a short window on Mar 27 02:00 UTC for the infra change and notify infra-oncall. Should be low-risk.

release-bot: release branch created: refs/heads/release/v2.3 by olivia at 1765432300

lex: One more test ask: include an accessibility smoke test for quickstarts. Sofia, can you add a11y checklist?

sofia: Yup — adding a short checklist to the quickstart PR template.

ada: Final question — who wants to be listed as on-call for post-release hotfixes? We should have one SDK, one docs, one sample-apps contact.

mike: I'll be SDK on-call for the first 24h.

sofia: Docs on-call for 24h.

jun: I'll cover sample apps.

olivia: Perfect. I'll send the calendar invites and the post-release runbook tonight. Everyone, please add your PR links to the release tracking doc: https://redwood.internal/release-tracker/v2.3 :thumbsup:
